value.headline: Matcha momentum is up 27.9% this cycle, but the cafe is £2,705 in the red.

industry_trend.claim: Wholesale matcha prices rose 30–60% in early 2026, compressing cafe gross margins on matcha drinks from about 70–75% to 50–55% unless prices are raised.

nudges.rationale: Attachment opportunity in matcha drinks is £207 weekly (445 of 5,458 weekly matcha_transactions include a food item; rate 0.082), meaning upselling a food item alongside matcha drinks could capture this incremental revenue.
nudges.title: Boost matcha drink attachments with a food upsell

value.sell_summary: Over the 13-week window you rang up £157,469 across 26,023 transactions, averaging £6.05 per basket. The Iced Matcha Latte has driven growth with £29,546 in revenue, while Filter Coffee remains the top revenue item at £44,612. Despite this top-line strength, the period ends with a net loss of £2,705, signaling a need to lift margins—most effectively by increasing food attachments to drinks and tightening waste from baking.
